steps.note: The whey is acidified, since at its own pH of about 6.5 the purity is far lower.

steps.name: pressurise
steps.note: The whey is held at 600 megapascals, which makes the beta-lactoglobulin clump and settle out, while the alpha-lactalbumin stays dissolved.

processing.text: These are the conditions of one pilot-scale study, in which beta-lactoglobulin is the fraction that precipitates; whether it is made this way commercially is not sourced.

links.name: Romo et al., Foods 2023: Separation of alpha-Lactalbumin Enriched Fraction from Bovine Native Whey Concentrate

sources.text: The precipitation of beta-lactoglobulin under high pressure and acid is from this study; it does not report a purity for the pellet.
